hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); printf '%s' "$cmd" | rg -q '\bgit\b([^|;&]*\s)?commit\b' || exit 0; repo="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; cd "$repo" || { echo "hook: no pude entrar a $repo" >&2; exit 2; }; test -f package.json || { echo "hook: $repo no es la raiz del proyecto" >&2; exit 2; }; npm run lint >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'lint FAILED - commit blocked' >&2; exit 2; }; npm run test:unit >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'test:unit FAILED - commit blocked' >&2; exit 2; }; echo 'lint + unit OK'
hooks.statusMessage: lint + unit tests antes del commit
